categories.label: Foreign-born Total
categories.source_period: Naturalized None, PR n/a, Temporary n/a
categories.estimation_basis: Sum of estimated naturalized, permanent resident, and temporary resident category outputs.

categories.label: Naturalized Citizens
categories.source_period: None census distribution scaled to current estimated stock
categories.estimation_basis: Latest naturalized census distribution scaled to the current estimated naturalized stock.

categories.label: Permanent Residents
categories.source_period: n/a IRCC annual distribution scaled to current estimated stock
categories.estimation_basis: Latest complete IRCC permanent resident distribution scaled to the current estimated stock.

categories.label: Temporary Residents
categories.source_period: Study n/a, work n/a, asylum n/a
categories.estimation_basis: Combined latest study, work, and asylum country distributions scaled to the current temporary resident total.

methodology.summary: Country-of-origin totals refresh automatically on every pipeline run. Each category reuses the newest available country distribution and scales it to the newest estimated stock total.
methodology.foreign_born_definition: Foreign-born total on this site is naturalized citizens plus permanent residents plus temporary residents.
